retrieval.corpus: all uniquely titled passages materialized from the pinned ten-row subset
retrieval.document_id: sha256(normalized title) first 16 lowercase hex characters
retrieval.ranking: distinct lowercase ASCII alphanumeric query/document token overlap; stable corpus order breaks ties
retrieval.context: retrieved document text joined in ranked order with two newlines

scorers.supporting_fact_recall: unique gold supporting titles present among retrieved document titles / unique gold supporting titles
scorers.answer_oracle: gold answer iff normalized gold answer is a substring of normalized retrieved context; empty string otherwise
scorers.answer_em: Imp.Metrics.em-compatible lowercase punctuation/article normalized exact match
scorers.answer_f1: Imp.Metrics.f1-compatible lowercase punctuation/article normalized token F1

limitations: This provider-free differential measures deterministic retrieval and answer availability, not language-model generation quality.
Ten pinned validation rows are bounded comparative evidence, not full HotPotQA effectiveness or paper-scale parity.
